node.title: A=1 core-one active-core two-sided partition
node.statement: In either remaining official active system, every clean slope gives a squarefree complementary partition Q_gamma A_gamma=G_X/X_0 of exact degrees (r,D_0-z-r), and every saturated domain row gives a squarefree complementary partition Q_xV_x=P of exact degrees (e_*,T-e_*). Both quotients attain their global degree bounds. The active bad-row clean incidences have exact total c e_*-C_*-E_bad, with the explicit D_*=0 and D_*=1 formulas (ATP8). This is the current degree-tight two-sided divisor-partition interface, not a classification.
